about: Roadmap 5.4: questions the chat must keep answering well. Every answer is checked for: the right tool (any of 'tools'; [] means it must ask back and call none), every number taken from the tool results or the question, at most 120 words, the words in must_include / must_not_include (any case; a list inside must_include means any one of its words will do), and a question with lang 'es' must get an answer in Spanish. 'offline' is true when the built-in offline chat (CI, and the fallback when Gemini fails) handles it; otherwise the reason it doesn't yet, and CI marks it as an expected failure (a to-do list, like PENDING in test_businesses.py). scripts/eval_live.py runs every question on the connected model. Add a question for every chat bug found.
